Bash(python3 << 'PYEOF'
import re

with open\("/Users/Brittany/Desktop/CardSage/components.js", "r"\) as f:
    content = f.read\(\)

# Find the markers
beyond_start = content.index\("{/* ── BEYOND THE NUMBERS — HIDDEN VALUE ── */}"\)
benefit_start = content.index\("{/* ── BENEFIT TRACKER ── */}"\)
retention_start = content.index\("{/* ── RETENTION OFFER SECTION ── */}"\)

# Go back to find the start of whitespace before each marker
# Beyond starts at the beginning of its line
beyond_line_start = content.rfind\("\\n", 0, beyond_start\) + 1
benefit_line_start = content.rfind\("\\n", 0, benefit_start\) + 1
retention_line_start = content.rfind\("\\n", 0, retention_start\) + 1

# Extract sections
before_beyond = content[:beyond_line_start]
beyond_section = content[beyond_line_start:benefit_line_start]  # includes trailing newline
benefit_section = content[benefit_line_start:retention_line_start]  # includes trailing newline
after_benefit = content[retention_line_start:]

# Swap: put Benefit first, then Beyond
new_content = before_beyond + benefit_section + beyond_section + after_benefit

with open\("/Users/Brittany/Desktop/CardSage/components.js", "w"\) as f:
    f.write\(new_content\)

print\("Swap complete"\)
print\(f"Beyond section: {len\(beyond_section\)} chars"\)
print\(f"Benefit section: {len\(benefit_section\)} chars"\)
PYEOF)
